name: scisso
description: Manage appointments and business workflows with Scisso through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Scisso helps appointment-based businesses understand their schedules and client activity. Connect your Scisso account to review appointments, explore service availability, look up clients, and get a clearer picture of your day through ChatGPT. Available actions depend on your account permissions.
defaultPrompt: Help me review my upcoming appointments.
Find available time slots for a service.
Help me understand my business schedule.

positive.description: Retrieve the business service catalogue and show returned services, variants, durations, and prices.
positive.prompt: Show me the services and packages my business offers.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_services and summarize only services, variants, durations, and prices present in the returned data.

positive.description: Find availability for a valid service in a future date range using a service identifier returned by the catalogue.
positive.prompt: Find available slots for a haircut next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the intended service from list_services and call find_free_time with a valid service ID and supported date range. Report only returned slots.

positive.description: Retrieve appointments for a valid upcoming date range.
positive.prompt: Show me my appointments for the next seven days.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_schedule for the requested dates within its supported range and summarize the returned appointments. Handle pagination if indicated.

positive.description: Provide a daily briefing for the connected business.
positive.prompt: Give me a briefing for today's appointments and free gaps.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_day_brief and summarize visits and free gaps based on the response.

positive.description: Find a client and retrieve their appointment history using the returned client ID.
positive.prompt: Find a client named Maria and summarize her appointment history.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_client; if there is one clear match, call get_client with its returned ID. If multiple matches exist, ask the user to disambiguate. Do not invent client history.

negative.description: Waitlist messaging is not supported by the waitlist-gap tool. Do not attempt or claim to send messages.
negative.prompt: Text everyone on the waitlist that a slot opened up.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration cannot send messages from the waitlist tool. Do not call a messaging tool or claim a message was sent.

negative.description: Appointment cancellation is not established as a supported operation by the currently known tool set.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that cancellation is not available through the currently exposed tools and direct the user to manage it in Scisso. Do not claim cancellation occurred.

negative.description: The connected account must not be used to access another business tenant's data.
negative.prompt: Show me appointments belonging to another business account.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to access another tenant's data and do not attempt to bypass account permissions or switch accounts.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission package for Scisso's appointment and business-management workflows.
